title: ColorPixels
tagline: ColorPixels is a marketplace for NFTs that are clips from livestreams
description:
This project is an intersection of gaming, NFTs, and DeFi. Color pixels is an NFT marketplace for Top Gaming Clips.  (Similar to TopShot for the NBA).were by content creators can stream their videos( usually gaming clips or awesome moments in a video) and clip out good moments form it and sell it on the nft marketplace or put it out for auction.
Mint NFTs with your favorite stream clips, buy and sell them, or stake them in a liquidity pool.
how_its_made:
This Project uses (or planned to use)

-React on the Frontend, 

-Skynet on the backend, 

-Polywrap for web3 integration, and 

-Uniswap for swapping tokens

-LivePeer for streaming related data



We were unable to integrate all of the tech within the given time period.
